name: DKP exchange live-pair valuation
summary: The direct DKP exchange valued its DKP inventory from the configured pair's live token balances. A two-receipt campaign caused the exchange to release DKP at a transient balance ratio and then removed canonical USDT from the same pair.

loss.notes: The canonical 18-decimal BSC USDT balance of pair 0xbe654 falls from 259,605.445236391899433885 before source-1 to 181,045.896092434246591772 after source-2. Receipt arithmetic agrees: source-1 sends 259,390 USDT to the helper, receives the 259,390 principal plus a 674.414 fee, and source-2 sends 79,233.963143957652842113 USDT to the EOA, for exact pair depletion of 78,559.549143957652842113 USDT. The helper also pays 100 USDT through 0xb24fc to constructor-fixed specifyusdtAddr 0xb6df; that address is the DKP protocol's recurring exchange-revenue and distribution account and retains the amount, so entity-level loss is 78,459.549143957652842113 USDT. DKP moves internally across the harmed entity set: exchange -17,115.243270155346986000, pair +16,178.183701114341738517, DKP token fee inventory +851.483352690228512552, and constructor-fixed connectionAddr +85.576216350776734930. Their one-wei shortfall is the token's integer fee truncation, not attacker-held consideration; helper DKP starts and ends at zero. At the pre-incident block, pair total supply is 97,597.498194969607267275 LP: owner-linked UsdtTokenPool holds 68,040.736000000000010000 (69.7156558911%), constructor-bound lpAddress holds 28,714.702564796886292017 (29.4215559782%), and the other 230 holders jointly hold 842.059630172720965258 (0.8627881305%). The pair inventory therefore represents the complete LP-holder victim set while the exchange, token-fee inventory and fixed revenue recipients conserve internal DKP. Source-3 bounds EOA nonces 131-139: helper creation, 932.745305403783296414-USDT funding, the two incident receipts, downstream approval and disposal of 78,000 USDT, and withdrawal of the helper's remaining 158.331305403783296414 USDT to the EOA. No later DKP or USDT returns to the exchange, pair or protocol recipients occur in the same-day actor/helper scan.

ageReset.description: The direct exchange constructor fixed canonical USDT, DKP, pair, invite, fee, setup-revenue and owner addresses. Its getUsdtPrice path reads the pair's live DKP and USDT balanceOf values and exchange uses that result to size the DKP inventory payment. The runtime was absent one block before creation, is unchanged before source-1, and the complete pre-incident call history contains no owner setter or configuration reset.

sources.note: Reviewed source-1 through source-4 receipts and call traces; every DKP and USDT transfer touching exchange 0x89257, pair 0xbe654, DKP token self, helper/EOA/intermediate, fixed connectionAddr 0x21539 and fixed specifyusdtAddr 0xb6df; archive balances before source-1 and after source-2; all pair LP Transfer events from creation through the pre-incident block; and actor/helper flows through the same-day no-return cutoff. The source-1 trace calls exchange(uint256) through 0xb24fc. The direct exchange first takes the fixed 100-USDT charge, queries invite state, reads DKP and USDT balanceOf for 0xbe654 through getUsdtPrice, and transfers 85.576216350776734930 DKP to connectionAddr plus 17,029.667053804570251070 DKP to the intermediate/helper path. Source-2 returns 16,178.183701114341738517 DKP to the pair, routes 851.483352690228512552 DKP to token fee inventory, and sends 79,233.963143957652842113 USDT to the EOA. Archive balances reproduce every declared delta, including the exact 100-USDT revenue credit and one-wei DKP fee truncation. The LP census has 232 positive holders: owner-linked UsdtTokenPool and constructor-bound lpAddress hold 99.1372118693% together and 230 other holders hold the remainder. Source-4 directly creates 0x89257 at block 26,135,620 index 75. Creation arguments fix pair 0xbe654, USDT 0x55d398, DKP 0xd06fa1, invite 0xb895, connectionAddr 0x21539, specifyusdtAddr 0xb6df and owner 0xc18d. The 10,897-byte runtime is absent at block 26,135,619 and hashes to 0xaad733dfae4756ffd80cfc08173e7853e23a7ede56e1d84dd65f88b77e6ee18b at creation and pre-incident. All 91 post-creation calls before source-1 invoke only exchange or profit collection; none invokes setSpecifyadd, setPropor, setConnectionAddr, operation, ownership transfer or another configuration path. Deployment is therefore the latest honest activation.
